index_title: Colorado STC — September 24, 2026 Meeting — Regular Session (Reports Only)

meeting.location: Colorado State Office · Denver Federal Center · Lakewood CO 80225 · OR Virtual Meeting via Teams

key_facts.summary: SED report — heavy focus on CEY repair as the SED's top priority since Aug 27.
key_facts.staffing: Hired Sam Hyslop (Mesa). CED applications open for Sedgwick, Phillips, Saguache/Rio Grande. Alamosa CED vacancy anticipated. PA hiring for Baca, Prowers, Washington, Mesa, and 2 in Weld. Additional PA consideration for Baca, Weld, Pueblo, Kiowa, Yuma. Farm Loan Chief application process open (Kim Lacy has been Acting >1 year).
key_facts.budget: GS: $29,378.31 travel left ($24k allocated to Farm Loans site visits + training; $5k for STC meeting Sep). CO: $34,170.69 travel (likely swept — Sep 15-17 Colorado Springs in-person training being DC-funded). Overtime being authorized more liberally than expected.
key_facts.weld_office: New lease at 8750 W 20th St, Greeley — targeting June 2027 move-in (possibly earlier).
key_facts.cey_priority: 'As directed by the STC, I continue to work on data to stabilize County Expected Yields (CEY).' Jerry quotes the 1-NAP standard verbatim and argues CEYs have dropped as much as 17% of the average due to use of disaster-year production data. Held producer meetings at Pueblo State Fair (5 days), Delta, Grand Junction; met with CSU Extension.
key_facts.outreach: State Fair Pueblo + visits to 2 large producers; CSU Ag Day + guest lecture with Sec Vilsack; producer meetings on local CEYs.

key_facts.summary: DD reports — District 1 Brase, District 2 Weishaar (acting), District 3 Woods (written), District 4 Montoya (oral).
key_facts.district_3_highlights: Woody Woods report — CRP: NRCS returning plans slowly for General/Continuous/Grasslands; State Land Board signatures slow. ARCPLC: base reallocation complete, recons open, 2026 signup begun. LFP: all counties accepting applications, many ahead. ELAP: trickling in for Feed Transportation. LIP: heat-loss inquiries received. Staffing: Monica Becker CED Phillips, Sharla Kinnison CED Sedgwick, PA postings for Weld (2) + Washington (1). Crops: NI corn ears not filling, being hayed/silaged; NI wheat drilling begun. Weather: moisture needed.
